sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "flight"."aid" AS e, SUM("flight"."price") AS m1 FROM "flight" GROUP BY "flight"."aid"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: total of ticket price per aircraft (by aid) (additive)
share of the all total of total of ticket price (all level)
gap to the all average of total of ticket price (all level)
